# searchstax_ip_filter (Resource)





## Import

Import an existing IP filter with `account_name/deployment_uid/cidr_ip`.

```shell
terraform import searchstax_ip_filter.example account_name/deployment_uid/cidr_ip
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `cidr_ip` (String)
- `deployment_uid` (String)
- `services` (List of String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
